class.name: ResonanceProbeVolume
class.brief_description: 3D region for Steam Audio probe placement and baked reverb / pathing.
class.description: Defines where probes are placed ([member generation_type], [member spacing]) and stores results in [member probe_data]. Assign a [url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url] to [member bake_config] for per-volume quality and Bake Ambisonic Order. Bake via the inspector or Project -> Tools -> Nexus Resonance -> Bake. Reflection type and pathing on/off follow [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] on [ResonanceRuntime], not BakeConfig. Add [ResonanceProbeExclusion] descendants to skip probe regions. Clear [member ResonancePlayer.pathing_probe_volume] before deleting a referenced volume.

method.name: generate_probes_on_floor_raycast
method.description: Uniform Floor: raycasts down for floor hits and returns world-space probe positions. Main thread only.

method.name: reload_probe_batch
method.description: Reloads [member probe_data] into [ResonanceServer] without restarting the game.

method.name: release_probe_batch
method.description: Unloads this volume's probe batch from [ResonanceServer] and clears the local handle.

method.name: get_probe_batch_handle
method.description: Server probe-batch handle for this volume, or [code]-1[/code] if unloaded.

method.name: set_headless_baking_mode
method.description: When true, skips editor-only UI/disk assumptions for runtime/RAM baking ([url=#ResonanceRuntimeBaker]ResonanceRuntimeBaker[/url]). Not shown in the inspector.

method.name: is_headless_baking_mode
method.description: True when headless/runtime bake mode is active.

method.name: get_bake_params_hash
method.description: Hash of volume layout params for outdated-[member probe_data] detection. Excludes [member ResonanceBakeConfig.bake_num_threads].

method.name: get_viz_color_state
method.description: Editor probe viz: [code]0[/code] gray (missing/outdated), [code]1[/code] blue (ok), [code]2[/code] red (settings mismatch).

method.name: set_viz_color_state
method.description: Sets editor probe visualization color. Called when bake status or config changes.

method.name: notify_runtime_config_changed
method.description: Called by [ResonanceRuntime] when reflection, pathing, or bake Ambisonic Order changes. Updates editor viz (red/gray on mismatch).

method.name: resolved_bake_ambisonic_order
method.description: Resolves [member ResonanceBakeConfig.bake_ambisonics_order]: Use Global returns [param p_global_order] clamped to 1-3; else the override.

method.name: ensure_default_resources
method.description: Ensures [member probe_data] and [member bake_config] exist. Safe to call repeatedly (editor create/inspect).

method.name: collect_exclusion_boxes
method.description: Enabled descendant [ResonanceProbeExclusion] boxes as dictionaries ([code]xform[/code], [code]size[/code]), sorted by path.

method.name: notify_exclusion_changed
method.description: Called when a child [ResonanceProbeExclusion] changes. Refreshes preview and bake outdated detection.

method.name: add_bake_source
method.description: Appends a [ResonancePlayer] bake target ([NodePath] or [Node]). Dedupes; does not bake.

method.name: add_bake_listener
method.description: Appends a [ResonanceListener] bake target ([NodePath] or [Node]). Dedupes; does not bake.

members.member: [url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url] for this volume. Auto-created when empty in the editor. Null at bake time uses [method ResonanceBakeConfig.create_default].
[ResonanceProbeData] with baked probes. Auto-created when empty. Required for baked reverb at runtime.
Probe region size in meters (X, Y, Z).
Distance between probes in meters (0.5-20). Smaller = more probes, longer bakes.
Probe plane height for Uniform Floor (0.1-5). Editable only when [member generation_type] is Uniform Floor.
Draw probe spheres in the editor when selected. Editor-only.
Editor scale of probe sphere gizmos (0.1-3).
NodePaths scanned by Update Targets to fill [member bake_sources] / [member bake_listeners].
[ResonancePlayer] NodePaths for Static Source bakes. Prefer [method add_bake_source] / [method remove_bake_source]. Empty = skip.
[ResonanceListener] NodePaths for Static Listener bakes. Prefer [method add_bake_listener] / [method remove_bake_listener]. Empty = skip.
Influence radius (m) for static source/listener bakes when the target has no custom radius (1-50000).

constants.constant: Single probe at the volume center.
